subject.title: Gateway: account-scoped channel config changes restart the entire channel and can disrupt active traffic

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the generic account-scoped channel reload contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99312 across channel plugins, or require plugin-specific opt-in first?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but changing reload fanout for every account-capable channel is a compatibility-sensitive gateway contract decision that automation should not finalize without gateway owner intent.

options.title: Adopt generic account-scoped reloads
options.body: Approve the current PR direction so channels.<kind>.accounts.<id> changes restart only affected accounts, with whole-channel fallbacks for default, global, mixed, removed, or non-canonical account changes.

options.title: Require plugin capability opt-in
options.body: Ask the PR to add an explicit channel-plugin capability before account-scoped restart behavior applies beyond proven plugins.

options.title: Keep whole-channel restarts
options.body: Reject the behavior change for now and document that account-scoped config edits remain whole-channel reload events until a narrower contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Adopt generic account-scoped reloads
recommendation.body: Approve the current PR direction so channels.<kind>.accounts.<id> changes restart only affected accounts, with whole-channel fallbacks for default, global, mixed, removed, or non-canonical account changes.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway reload and channel-helper history makes this the strongest available owner for the cross-plugin reload contract decision.
